verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe returned HTTP 200 for a publicly downloadable OpenAPI document at docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json containing an "openapi" key. The REST reference docs (for example, the POST /v1/request/query page) are consistent with that machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that points users to the spec download, and evidence of how many endpoints the spec covers and how it is versioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json — contains "openapi" key
